original_goal:
[Module: Product Inventory | TC-008 | Type: Edge/State | Priority: Medium]
Title: Double-click Add on a NotInCart product increments cart by exactly one

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "product_p": "Sauce Labs Backpack"
}

Preconditions:
  User is logged in; product P is in NotInCart state; cart badge shows current count N

Steps to Execute:
  1. Locate product P in the product list (use Sauce Labs Backpack as product P)
  2. Click the Add to cart button for product P
  3. Immediately click the Add to cart button for product P again (second click before UI updates)

Expected Result:
  Only the first click succeeds; cart badge increments by exactly 1; button text changes to Remove; no duplicate increment or error message occurs

Notes from prior verification:
  DOM snapshot contains Add to cart buttons required for the double-click interaction. Behavioral outcome must be asserted at runtime.
expected_outcome: Only the first click succeeds; cart badge increments by exactly 1; button text changes to Remove; no duplicate increment or error message occurs
